latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator AI — Generate Captions for Videos.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM (up to 500MB) and generate captions in English and Spanish with auto-sync in 30–60 seconds.
- No installation required; all captioning and rendering runs on remote GPU servers.
- Simple, guided setup with automatic connection to backend and easy authentication (100 free credits).
- Quick workflows for captioning, previewing, and exporting videos; batch and iterative editing supported.
- Supports multiple file formats and full session-based timeline state management.
- Clear error handling, tips, and automated status updates to ensure a smooth user experience.
